rust_declaration.name: contains
rust_declaration.source_text:
pub const fn contains<U>(&self, item: &U) -> bool
    where
        Idx: [const] PartialOrd<U>,
        U: ?Sized + [const] PartialOrd<Idx>,
    {
        <Self as RangeBounds<Idx>>::contains(self, item)
    }

trusted_assumptions: vstd specifications for RangeBounds::start_bound and RangeBounds::end_bound on RangeTo.
vstd conditional specification for PartialOrd::lt under obeys_partial_cmp_spec().
rationale: The source retains its single RangeBounds delegation. A proof-local trait implementation copies the exact default body and proves it compositionally from smaller vstd contracts without axioms.
